"火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. 字源 p. 885 records the wording ‘可能指的是火星’ without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars; the CUHK entries identify the historical star name as 大火/心宿二. The reason for the name is unresolved."

"The star-name use of 火 is distinct from its literal ‘fire’ use. For 合集 11503, 字源 p. 885 says the passage may refer to 火星 but does not specify 心宿二 or the planet Mars; the CUHK entries identify the historical star name as 大火/心宿二. The sources do not explain why the star was named 火 or how that name relates to ‘fire’."
